title: Acquire and validate the place boundary and identifier registry
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
build-places.ts and geography-manifest.json are uncommitted working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status.

The chosen source is wmgeolab/geoBoundaries gbOpen release 6.0.0, commit 1289e40e366c7b320550be1ee0614a9472d572d4, committed 2023-09-13T20:20:48Z. The geoboundaries.org current API is a later build and was not used as the revision.
Bytes were read from Git LFS media at that commit. The git blobs themselves are LFS pointers. Geometries are not stored in this repository.

The project LICENSE and CITATION-AND-USE at that commit state CC-BY-4.0 and require attribution to geoBoundaries plus each file boundarySource. That statement does not replace the boundaryLicense on a file.
712 metadata files were read: 305 attribution, 280 share-alike, 116 public-domain or CC0, 5 unreviewed source terms, and 6 not a reusable grant. Share-alike files stay share-alike.

Unreviewed and withheld: every CHE level (swisstopo) and ESP ADM2 (INE). Not a reusable grant: OMN ADM2, SLB ADM3, SLB ADM4, TUV ADM3, VUT ADM3 (Other - Direct Permission) and TWN ADM0 (Pixabay License for Content).

Municipality detail is partial. 56 of 231 directories have a boundaryCanonical in a closed municipal label set (61 files). 55 of those have an open file. CHE ADM3 is labeled Municipality (2286 units) and is withheld. USA ADM2 is Counties, not municipalities. 23 directories are ADM0 only. PRI has no ADM0 file. Unrecognized local words are not counted. A label is not completeness.

shapeName has no language column and no alternate-name table. Sample language codes were identified from the observed name form. English shapeName Albania pairs with Shqipëria, and Vietnam pairs with Việt Nam. NLD ADM2 includes 's-Gravenhage and Noardeast-Fryslân and does not include Den Haag.
Opened CHN, SAU, GRC, and THA ADM1 simplified files use ASCII exonyms. The CHN file includes a shape named Taiwan Province. This registry does not decide that claim.
shapeISO was empty on the opened NLD ADM2 feature Groningen. ISO 3166-2 is not guaranteed. shapeID is the geometry id and boundaryID is the file id.

The default download layout is hierarchical metadata only: geography/country/, geography/admin/, and geography/place/. Those 712 files total 635323 bytes. Simplified and full-resolution geometries, shapefiles, and global composites are outside the layout.
Postal codes are absent. Enclaves, holes, antimeridian cuts, and disputed borders were not topology-tested. This module does not resolve a coordinate and does not join a law issuer.

The geography audit checks the manifest and that build-places.ts is a module mentioning attribution and license. It does not execute the TypeScript. A separate builder run with node --experimental-strip-types --check matched the manifest. That builder run wrote an experimental type-stripping warning to stderr. The audit stderr was empty.

geography.license: geoBoundaries project statement is CC-BY-4.0. Geometry redistribution follows each file boundaryLicense.
geography.attribution: geoBoundaries, www.geoboundaries.org. Cite Runfola et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866, and the boundarySource named in each file.

validation.env_note: PATH was exactly /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin. node is /usr/bin/node. HOME was /tmp/ipfs-accelerate-validation-home-UhEXnr. XDG paths were $HOME/.cache, $HOME/.config, $HOME/.local/share, and $HOME/.local/state. stderr was empty.
